description:
Bring the warmth of the French countryside into your nursery with the French Country Crib. Featuring a classic slat-style front and elegant turned spindles, this 4-in-1 convertible crib is a beautiful centerpiece for your nursery.

Handcrafted from solid wood with careful craftsmanship. This crib shows the timeless French Country aesthetic with its gently curved panels and heirloom-quality construction. The 4-in-1 design converts from crib to toddler bed, daybed, and full-size (double) bed, growing with your child from newborn through adolescence. Three adjustable mattress positions let you customize the height as your baby grows, keeping safety front of mind.

All finishes are non-toxic and baby-safe, meeting or exceeding CPSC and ASTM safety standards.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
